english.note: Use this when you want to stress replacing people or manual labor with machines rather than merely making a process automatic.

examples.english: The new system will automate the work, replacing the people who used to do it.
examples.traditional: 新系統會用機器代替人手，做埋以前要幾個人做嘅工。
